_comment: APEX GHOST — Awakening Video Asset Registry
_instructions: Add the full path to each motivational video on your machine.
Videos play IN ORDER from top to bottom — sequence them intentionally.
You can add as many videos as you want — just extend the 'videos' array.
Set 'enabled: false' to temporarily skip a video without deleting it.
Run 'python -m automation.awakening --force' to test the full sequence.
